Born 29 Apr 1912 at Sutherlin, Oregon, the second child of George F. Adams, pharmacist, and Serena Trumbo. Her birth certificate is marked "ALTERED": her given names, Edith Van Tyne, were added later by affidavit. Van Tyne is her grandmother Mary Frances Vantine's surname.

In 1930 she was 17, a stepdaughter in Arthur T. Wells's household at Burlingame. She married Thomas White Childs about 1934 (married 16 years in 1950); they lived in Philadelphia in 1935 and in Portland, Oregon, from 1940, with their sons George C. and Gregg E. Childs. She died on 10 May 2000 and was buried beside Thomas at Willamette National Cemetery.
